verdict_reason: HTTP coverage misses pagination wiring and AC1 row fields; remaining issues are style and isolation nits.

todos.issue: GET /notifications is never called with page, so a controller that drops the page param would still pass this IT; pagination is only asserted as default page 1.
todos.fix: Seed more than page-size rows and GET /notifications?page=2, asserting the second slice plus size/totalPages.

todos.issue: List assertions only check referenceNumber; AC1 also requires status, origin country, commodity and arrival date on each row, and seed never sets commodity.
todos.fix: Seed commodity and assert jsonPath for status, originCountry, commodity and arrivalDate on a returned row.

todos.issue: The named exact-match test only picks one of two complete references; a prefix or contains lookup of GBN-AG-26-002 would still pass, so AC4 exact-match is not locked.
todos.fix: Add a case that GET with a prefix or substring of a stored reference returns empty content.

todos.issue: New IT methods omit the required Given / When / Then comment blocks used in NotificationSqsListenerIT and mandated by the integration testing guide.
todos.fix: Add // Given, // When, // Then (or // When / Then) comments to each test.

todos.issue: setup drops the Mongo collection instead of deleting documents via the repository, which diverges from IntegrationBase guidance and from NotificationSqsListenerIT.
todos.fix: Inject AggregatedNotificationRepository and call deleteAll() in @BeforeEach.
